description: Take a live R3 project offline: its public live URL stops working at once, and the live-project slot it used on the plan is free again. Only when the user asked for it. Other people open a live project, so one that blocks an r3_project_delete goes offline only once the user has been asked and agreed, never as a step of the delete. Deletes nothing: the project, and any preview link, stay; r3_publish_live makes it live again. A project that is not live is refused and left as it is. Needs the publish:live right.
name: r3_unpublish_live

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Take a live project offline
